description: This file provides a stub implementation of the DevService interface specifically for Windows builds. It includes methods for running, stopping, and checking the development mode, all of which currently return not supported errors. It imports project-specific domain and interface packages and defines a DefaultDevService struct.

classes.name: DefaultDevService
classes.description: A stub implementation of DevService for Windows builds.

methods.name: RunInDevMode
methods.description: Attempts to run the development mode but currently returns an error indicating it's not supported on Windows.

methods.name: StopDevMode
methods.description: Attempts to stop the development mode but currently returns an error indicating it's not supported on Windows.

methods.name: GetDevStatus
methods.description: Attempts to get the development status but currently returns an error indicating it's not supported on Windows.
